cmd: cd /app && ls -la && cat /etc/os-release && which nginx || echo "no nginx"
apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq nginx curl 2>&1 | tail -5
cat /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
read_file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
head -30 /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
edit_file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

mkdir -p /var/www/html && printf 'Welcome to the benchmark webserver' > /var/www/html/index.html && printf 'Page not found - Please check your URL' > /var/www/html/404.html && rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default && echo done
mkdir -p /var/www/html
python3 -c "open('/var/www/html/index.html','w').write('Welcome to the benchmark webserver'); open('/var/www/html/404.html','w').write('Page not found - Please check your URL')"
nginx -t 2>&1 && (service nginx restart 2>&1 || nginx 2>&1); sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:8080/ && echo && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/missing
read_file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
grep -n "access_log\|error_log" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
ls -la /etc/nginx/ | head; ls -la /etc/nginx/conf.d/
grep -n "include" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf; grep -n "log_format\|limit_req_zone" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
sed -n '25,45p' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/etc/nginx/nginx.conf'
s=open(p).read()
add='''
	##
	# Custom Log Format
	##

	log_format benchmark '$time_local "$request_method" $status "$http_user_agent"';

	##
	# Rate Limiting
	##

	limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark:10m rate=10r/s;
'''
s=s.replace("\n\tinclude /etc/nginx/mime.types;", add+"\n\tinclude /etc/nginx/mime.types;",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
nginx -t 2>&1
sed -n '26,45p' /etc/nginx/nginx.conf

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/etc/nginx/nginx.conf'
s=open(p).read()
bad='''
etc/##
etc/# Custom Log Format
etc/##

etc/log_format benchmark '$time_local "$request_method" $status "$http_user_agent"';

etc/##
etc/# Rate Limiting
etc/##

etc/limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark:10m rate=10r/s;
'''
good='''
\t##
\t# Custom Log Format
\t##

\tlog_format benchmark '$time_local "$request_method" $status "$http_user_agent"';

\t##
\t# Rate Limiting
\t##

\tlimit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark:10m rate=10r/s;
'''
assert bad in s
s=s.replace(bad,good,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("fixed")
PYEOF
nginx -t 2>&1
service nginx restart 2>&1; sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:8080/; echo; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/missing; tail -5 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

curl -s http://localhost:8080/missing; echo; ls -la /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/; grep -E "limit_req_zone|limit_req|log_format" /etc/nginx/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf; echo "--- access log location: /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log"

ls -la /var/www/html/; cat /var/www/html/index.html; echo; cat /var/www/html/404.html; echo; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/; nginx -t 2>&1; pgrep -a nginx | head -3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "root:%{http_code} " http://localhost:8080/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "404:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/nope
ps aux | grep -v grep | grep nginx; ls /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/ | wc -l; cat /etc/nginx/conf.d/benchmark-site.conf
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "final check: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/ && tail -2 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
